anomalies.observed: C1 is 0.1uF/16V, a 0.1 µF bulk capacitor on the Display_Power_Switch boost output, whereas the other output-side capacitors in the same position group are 1 µF/25 V.
anomalies.expected: The specification lists C1 alongside C5, C7, C8, C9 and C10 as 1 µF/25 V, the default output-capacitor value of the Pervasive Displays circuit. C1 should be 1 µF with a 25 V rating.
anomalies.impact: The panel supply node has roughly a tenth of the intended output capacitance and a lower voltage rating. This increases ripple on the boost output that feeds the EPD VDD/VDDIO rail and reduces margin for the boosted voltage, which can cause unstable display driving or panel faults.

anomalies.observed: C11 is a 0.1uF capacitor, but it uses an inductor footprint (Inductor_SMD:L_0805_2012Metric_Pad1.05x1.20mm_HandSolder). Pin 1 is on an unconnected net and only pin 2 reaches GND.
anomalies.expected: A 0.1 µF capacitor should use a capacitor footprint, and both terminals should be connected to be an effective decoupling capacitor.
anomalies.impact: The capacitor is electrically ineffective because one terminal floats. The wrong footprint could also cause a placement or soldering mismatch when the board is assembled.

parsed.summary: The design is largely consistent with the specification, but C1 deviates from its specified 1 µF/25 V value (now 0.1 µF/16 V) on the EPD boost output, and C11 is a capacitor in an inductor footprint with one terminal floating; C1 is the more significant deviation.
